description.value:
A burst of repulsor energy launches you skyward. You ascend a number of feet equal to 20 times your techcasting ability modifier, and during the leap you may also cover horizontal distance equal to 5 times that modifier. If you are still in the air at the end of the turn you cast this power, you settle safely to the ground.

Overcharge Tech. Casting this power with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher adds another 20 feet of vertical rise and 5 feet of horizontal movement for every slot level beyond 1st.
